saw_lines: Watch people buy straps to match a mood or an event, then judge fit and whether it changes in seconds.
So the sale is won in line one, where the buyer decides if the fit and price are worth a click.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 21 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers 25% off, yet 0 of 17 ads mention it or any offer, so a new buyer has no reason to act. Put the 25% off in the first line of three new ads and on the creative image.

Your site answers how fast orders ship, yet 0 of 20 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a buyer unsure about timing has no reason to buy. Open three new ads with your fulfillment time in the first line.

Your homepage shows a $150 price, yet 0 of 20 ads mention price, so a buyer comparing straps cannot judge value from the ad. Lead one new ad with that price beside what a comparable strap costs elsewhere.
None of your 20 live ads carries a proof number, so a first time buyer has nothing concrete to trust. Collect one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead with it in new ads.

ads_1: Lead new ads with the 25% off offer, tested against your current openers
